name: io.github.athril/agentic-target-evidence
title: Agentic Target Evidence
description: Read-only biomedical evidence tools for drug-target validation: DepMap, gnomAD, OpenTargets, PubMed…

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Run the gateway over stdio (the image defaults to HTTP).

environmentVariables.name: NCBI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional NCBI E-utilities key; raises the PubMed/ClinVar rate limit from 3 to 10 req/s.

environmentVariables.name: USPTO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional USPTO Open Data Portal key; the USPTO patent tools return nothing without it.
